title: 鲁氏（及特玉莲）杂交后代

segments.t: 资料来自ICN，由种花小医杂家赵收集、校对、翻译。 转载请注名翻译者及泛景站名。 鲁氏石莲花（E. runyonii ）和它的园艺变种特玉莲（Echeveria runyonii 'Topsy Turvy'）的杂交后代： 关于鲁氏和特玉莲本身的资料，详见 http://funjing.com/6581.htm Costa Brava E. peacockii 皮氏蓝石莲 x E. sp. (E. runyonii ?)鲁氏石莲花（存疑） Named by Eduardo Carbonell.
photo from ICN Glade Surprise   林地惊喜/爱尔兰薄荷 US hybrid, also distributed as E. 'Irish Mint' 美国杂交品种，常常被叫做“爱尔兰薄荷” Parents : Echeveria runyonii 'Topsy Turvy' & E. derenbergii 特玉莲和静夜的杂交品种

Photos Margrit Bischofberger The flowers can be somewhat misshaped, due to the E. runyonii 'Topsy Turvy' parent : 有时花会出现某种程度的变形，如它的亲本特玉莲一样:
Photo Emmanuelle Aubé RUNYONII 'Dr. Butterfield'

Photos Noelene Tomlinson RUNYONII 'Lucita' The plant is distributed as E. 'Lucita' - this suggests the plant is a hybrid, which is not true, it is either the species E. runyonii itself - given a new name by the trade - or it is a somewhat special form of E. runyonii given a cultivar name. In what it is different or special is not known. 这个品种也被描述为E. 'Lucita'，表明这种植物是一个杂交种，但这是不对的。它其实只是鲁氏石莲花本身，被赋予一个新名字用于出售。也许它的确与鲁氏石莲花有一些区别故给予一个园艺名称，但它（和鲁氏石莲花）的具体不同或特别之处并不明确。
